name: Vernal-Tarn
description: Silence has shape here: boulder fields, shattered scarps, knife-edge shadows, and far to the east, an orbital debris ring. Nothing wears any of it smooth.
There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure.
the smuggler cache changes hands often and quietly. Its current occupants trade fuel for silence and ask no questions about cargo.
Business at the outpost is steady and deniable. Newcomers are welcome, watched, and priced accordingly.
